heuristics.name: common-ISEE-headword match
heuristics.description: pick the option that is the plain synonym of a well-known ISEE headword (e.g. sporadic=intermittent, stingy=parsimonious)

heuristics.name: antonym-pair member
heuristics.description: when two options are antonyms (amass/squander, lull/commotion, submit/rebel), pick one of the pair, preferring the more test-worthy sense

heuristics.name: rarest word
heuristics.description: pick the least common word when nothing else discriminates (wheedle, upbraid, petulant, brandish)

heuristics.name: near-synonym cluster centre
heuristics.description: pick the centre of a cluster of semantically close options (salvage among forage/loot; wince among shudder)

notes: Options-only synonyms carry essentially no signal: each set is four unrelated plain words. All 60 picks are guesses; no option could be ruled out with certainty, so reject_certain is false throughout.
